slide_size.note: Backgrounds are 3840x2160 JPEGs (2x). Coordinates below are in 1920x1080 px; multiply by 2 for the background image.

partner_logo.type: rounded square frame (white fill, orange ring)
partner_logo.placeholder_text: LOGO (clear it when inserting the logo)
partner_logo.logo_rule: fit (contain) the logo into logo_inner_box, keep aspect ratio, center; square/round logos look best; for a wide wordmark use the icon if available

partner_name.fit_rule: wrap on word boundaries only; if a single word is wider than 200px or text needs >2 lines, reduce font size down to 16pt

other_slides: 2-9 are full-bleed background images, no fields

backgrounds.note: slide-1.jpg is the clean slide 1 without the partner block; draw logo frame + texts on it using box_px x2
